step.title: Organize your disc collection
step.detail: PickADisk is a application to store and index your disc collection into DC-101 and DC-300 carousels.

step.title: PickADisk Startup Window
step.detail:
This is the PickADisk startup window.

Some of the more non-obvious parts are described and will be discussed in later slides.

step.title: License Notice
step.detail: Upon first startup of PickADisk you will receive this dialog. Click on the appropriate button.

step.title: Check for updates window
step.detail: This dialog will be shown on the 2nd launch of the application.

step.title: PickADisk Startup Window
step.detail: Click either add button to begin the process.

step.title: Select strorage device
step.detail: Select a storage device to be used.

step.title: Select slot number
step.detail:
The next available slot number will be entered automatically.

If you desire a specific slot, you may enter the number in one of two ways.
Type in the slot number using the keyboard.
Click on the wheel and drag to select the number.
If the slot number already contains a disc you will see the title in the title box.
If you click on the arrow the device will go to the numbered slot and eject the disc.

step.title: Select disc
step.detail:
Select the disc to be added. 
Use the popup menu to select the drive to be used, the title box will be filled in automatically.

step.title: Enter a title for the disc
step.detail: Enter the title manually if you don't like the automatic generated name.

step.title: Select the type of disc
step.detail:
The type of disc is detected automatically.
If you prefer a different type, use the popup menu to select the type of disc.

step.title: Set the scanning level
step.detail:
Set the desired scanning level. This will control how much detail of the content of the disc will be included in the index.
The far left setting will only scan the top level content of the disc.
The far right setting will index the entire disc.

The settings default value can be controlled for different types of discs in the preferences panel.

step.title: Add the disc to the device
step.detail:
Click on the Add button to add the disc.

Repeat the steps to keep adding discs to the device.

lesson.title: Adding additional information
lesson.detail: After adding a disc you may desire to add additional information to make subsequent search and retrieval easier.

step.title: Select storage device
step.detail:
To enter additional information, select the storage device from the side panel.
The contents of the device will be displayed.

step.title: Locate the disc
step.detail:
Since you generally add discs in incrementing values, click on the Slot column to sort the list by slot number.
If the most recent disc is not at the top, click the SSlot column again to sort in the opposite direction.

Select the disc you wish to add additional information.

step.title: Select the disc
step.detail: Click and select the disc you wish to modify.

step.title: Select the Inspector panel
step.detail: Open the Inspector panel

step.title: Inspector Panel
step.detail: Change the indicated fields as you desire.

step.title: Select Result
step.detail:
Results are displayed. 

Click on column headings to sort the results.

step.title: Retreive disc
step.detail:
Results are displayed. 

Click on column headings to sort the results.

step.title: Discovery pane
step.detail: Controls behavior when discs are mounted and ejected

step.title: Discovery on Check In
step.detail: If you have a recognized disc mount and you select Check In you may have the device go to the assigned slot or simply do nothing,

step.title: Discovery for Check Out
step.detail: Controls behavior when you select Check Out.

step.title: Update pane
step.detail: Controls the automatic updating of the application.

step.title: Driver pane
step.detail: The driver should be installed automatically, if for some reason know only to the Gods it is not, use this pane to install and remove the driver as directed by PickADisk support.

step.title: Scanning pane
step.detail:
Controls the depth of folder scanning for various types of files.
Left most setting is top level only, rightmost is entire content of disc (can be slow on large content discs)

step.title: Window details
step.detail: Widen the window if you have all columns turned on

step.title: Enter License
step.detail:
There are several ways to enter your license.

Double click on the attachment in the license email (assumes you are using Apple Mail)
Double click on the license file (sent as an email attachment)
Drag the license file to the window
Click the Choose button and navigate to the license file.
